title: Missing Whole Puzzles
objective: Given both parts, find the whole — the companion case to missing-part puzzles, reinforcing composing in bond form.
studentQuestion: If you know both parts, what's the whole?

teaching.setup: A bond with both parts shown (e.g. 6 and 3), whole blank.
teaching.see: Both parts are here. What whole do they make?
teaching.break: Combine the two parts (counting on or a known fact).
teaching.transform: Two separate known parts — one combined named whole.

examples.second: Parts 7 and 2, whole 9 (same whole via different parts).
examples.transfer: Three parts given at once, find the whole.

mastery.evidence: Correctly finds the whole from two given parts for 3 different pairs.
